release_title: Sonus v2.6.3 — Critical Bug Fixes & Playlist Synchronization
release_notes: Fixed critical bug where playlist tracks were duplicated upon undoing deletion
Resolved state desynchronization and race conditions in cloud library synchronization
Fixed session authorization token refresh and heartbeat connection drops
Enhanced audio engine stream stability and automatic multi-source failover handling
Optimized local database caching and reduced memory footprint during extended playback
General performance improvements and UI responsiveness enhancements
